title: Ground Studio picture slots (upload, keep, finish, remove) and the game reading them
oneLine: Each swatch version's upload, seamless tile and finished picture across five maps and two IndexedDB stores.
topConcern: Game worker replaces the game copy per id with any studio entry: owner's phone hides game versions or newer chat-added pictures others see.

title: Ground Studio "made from an older prompt" marks (brief and time stamps)
oneLine: Per-version brief and time stamps deciding which pictures and blends are marked to make again.
topConcern: Zip keeps one madeFrom per swatch and restore stamps A, B and E with it, and re-stamps every time: stale marks lost or invented.

title: Ground Studio "seamless the new way" remake stamp
oneLine: One-time remake of saved seamless tiles behind the stored prepMade version string.

title: Ground Studio shared palette: automatic, frozen, or each swatch its own (dormant)
oneLine: Shared ground palette mode (automatic or frozen), pinned to per-swatch own colours since v2.3.2961.
topConcern: Restore always saves the palette, wiping a pre-v2.3.2961 frozen palette if ownColours ever returns to 0.

title: Ground Studio preview: lay the ground, then paint (compose loop)
oneLine: Preview compose dedupe: one in-flight promise plus a dirty flag, re-checked until the laid ground covers the view.
topConcern: Preview's 1024 game px phone height predates the game's zoom-outs (now about 1330): about 1.3x zoomed in.

title: Ground Studio page boot (S.ready) and its handlers
oneLine: Page boot: load every saved picture, then render and wire all buttons.
topConcern: One saved picture whose tile and upload both fail to decode throws out of loadAll; nothing is wired, so no backup, restore or remove.

title: Ground Studio footstep choices and the walk player
oneLine: Owner's per-ground footstep sound choices (planned or changed) and the page's lazily built audio player.
topConcern: Restore replaces all step choices with the zip's ({} when none) while merging pictures: newer choices silently lost, owner's game follows.

title: Object Studio: where each object's pieces come from (its own picture wins, else its sheet)
oneLine: Per object source: none, made from its sheet, or its own picture, which always wins.
topConcern: Restore and the MADE re-make keep an own picture that no longer cuts: 'not made', no Remove, sheet shadowed, left out of backups.

title: Object Studio sheet pictures: found, named, re-read, removed
oneLine: Sheet pictures: parts found by count, auto-named in reading order, renamed by the owner, re-read on finder change.
topConcern: Owner's sheet names survive restore only if the same part count is found; a keyOut change (MADE) silently replaces them with guesses.

title: Object Studio boot and its once-only remakes (MADE, FINDER, SIZES_BASE)
oneLine: Page boot and three stored stamps that drive one-time remakes of sizes, sheets and pieces.
topConcern: An unreadable stored piece PNG with matching stamps throws (no try) out of loadAll; no buttons are wired, so no backup or restore.

title: Object Studio stage: the one object shown at game size
oneLine: The one object shown at game size beside the bro: hidden, drawing, showing.
topConcern: 'As big as on your phone' uses the pre-v2.3.2997 view (1024 px); the game shows about 1330, so the stage is about 1.36x too big.

title: Object Studio "made from an older prompt" marks (prompt fingerprints)
oneLine: Prompt fingerprint per object picture and per sheet, with a size-only case for grown buildings.

title: Style Lab preview: open, walk, close (the rAF loop)
oneLine: Full-screen preview overlay: opening, open with its rAF loop, switching looks, closed.
topConcern: Closing during openPreview's awaits still starts the rAF loop, which draws a window-size canvas every frame behind the hidden overlay.

title: Style Lab saved work: pictures, scores and settings, and their caches
oneLine: Lab pictures in IndexedDB or memory, scores and settings in localStorage, two at-keyed caches.
topConcern: No busy overlay: two quick uploads to one slot keep whichever finishes last and leak the other's object URL.

title: Style Lab scene: the bro's walk, the demo stroll, and the scene's build cache
oneLine: Stand-in screen: bro steered, resting, strolling or walled in; device-size build cache; weather drops.
topConcern: Scene, ground preview and object stage hard-code the game's 1024 px phone height; the game now shows about 1330 after the zoom-outs.

title: Studio toasts, the busy overlay, and the download links (all three pages)
oneLine: Per-page toast timer, full-screen busy overlay used as the edit mutex, revoked download links.
